content:
The **Fasnacht Donut** is a consumable item in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Wild Appalachia* update.

A Helvetian delicacy served during Fasnacht. It has a 100% drop chance as a reward.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Brahmin Milk (3) Cooking Oil (1) Frog Egg (2) Razorgrain Flour (1) Salt (1) Spices (1) Wood (1) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:**Learned from plan/recipe Recipe: Fasnacht Donut | | Fasnacht Donut (1) | 

- Four can be found near the Jolly Baker in Helvetia during the limited-time Fasnacht Day event.
- Can be crafted at any Cooking Station with the correct ingredients, after learning the Recipe.
- May be found in the Fasnacht Collectron station, when it is run in "Treats" collection mode.

The Fasnacht donut was created by John Valenti, who also modeled several other items for Fasnacht Day. [1] 

1. ↑ Author attribution tags acquired via Nifskope for fasnacht_doughnut01.nif.
